# youtrack_notification_template (Resource)

Manages the content of a built-in YouTrack notification template (FreeMarker). YouTrack has no API to reset a template, so destroying this resource only removes it from the state. Use **Reset to default** in Administration → Notification Templates to restore the original content.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "youtrack_notification_template" "templates" {
  for_each = fileset("${path.module}/templates", "*.ftl")
  id       = trimsuffix(each.value, ".ftl")
  content  = file("${path.module}/templates/${each.value}")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) FreeMarker source of the template.
- `id` (String) ID of the template, for example `helpdesk_footer`. This matches the file name without the `.ftl` extension.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import 'youtrack_notification_template.templates["helpdesk_footer.ftl"]' helpdesk_footer
```
